transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net technical support, my name is Bradley. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello Bradley. I am so annoyed with this TV box. Ever since the software update ran automatically yesterday, the voice remote has completely broken. The microphone button does nothing, and the remote only works if I point it directly at the sensor from two feet away!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can help you troubleshoot the TV remote control. Before we do, let's complete account verification. What is your full name and the installation address?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Fiona MacLeod, 34 Glenurquhart Road, Inverness, IV3 5PB.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And what is the security PIN on the account, Fiona?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: What make and model of television is the S-Net TV box connected to?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It is connected to a fifty-five-inch LG OLED television.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: When you press the microphone button on the remote, does the blue microphone icon appear in the corner of your TV screen?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No, nothing appears on screen at all, and the little light on the remote doesn't illuminate.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That means the remote has fallen back to infrared line-of-sight mode because the Bluetooth connection dropped during the box firmware update.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I bought this voice service specifically so my visually impaired son could search for children's shows without fiddling with tiny menus! It is infuriating that your updates keep breaking things!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The overnight firmware upgrade patched the Android TV security layer across all set-top boxes.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I don't care about security patches if basic functions stop working.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Obviously Bluetooth peripherals require re-authentication if the cryptographic handshake keys are rotated.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Well, how do we re-authenticate it?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Take the remote and stand about three feet in front of the TV box.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Standing right in front of the box.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: First we need to wipe the old Bluetooth pairing. Hold down the Home button and the Back button together for five seconds.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Holding Home and Back together... The red LED at the top is flashing rapidly.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Release the buttons when the red flash stops. Now pull one of the AAA batteries out of the back of the remote.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Battery removed.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Wait ten seconds, put the battery back in, and look at the TV screen.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Battery replaced.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: While we are on the remote settings, would you like to pair the remote to control your LG TV's volume and power directly?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can it control the TV power as well? That would mean putting away the other remote!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, go into Settings on the TV box, select 'Remotes & Accessories', and click 'Set up TV buttons'.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Clicked Set up TV buttons. It's asking for the TV brand.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Select 'LG'. The box will send three test power codes to your television.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Selected LG. Code 1 was sent... The TV muted immediately!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Confirm that the volume buttons now adjust the LG television internal speakers.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Pressed volume down, and the LG volume bar appeared! That is so convenient!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Now press and hold the Voice button and the OK button simultaneously.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Holding Voice and OK together...

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The LED should flash blue twice to indicate Bluetooth pairing mode.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes! It flashed blue twice, and a message on the TV screen says 'Searching for remote accessories'.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Keep pointing the remote at the box while the firmware re-pairs. Bear with me for thirty seconds.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for waiting, Fiona. Does the screen now display 'S-Net Voice Remote Connected'?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes! It says 'Remote Connected via Bluetooth, Battery Level 100%'.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let me check the TV hardware again. What make and model of television is the box plugged into?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: As I told you earlier, it's an LG OLED fifty-five inch.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Right, now test pressing the microphone button and say 'Open YouTube'.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Pressed the mic button and said 'Open YouTube'... The microphone wave graphic lit up, and YouTube is opening on screen!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Now test voice searching for a specific programme, like 'BBC News'.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Said 'BBC News'... It displayed search results for live BBC channels instantly!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And can you test controlling volume from across the room without pointing directly at the box?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I'm walking back to the sofa around the corner... Pressed volume up, and the TV volume changed smoothly! Bluetooth is completely back!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That confirms full omnidirectional Bluetooth coverage and voice microphone operation are restored.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: My son will be so happy he can use his voice commands again.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Just to confirm your billing contact email on file, it's fiona dot macleod at highland dot scot, correct?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, that's my email.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I will leave notes on your account so future firmware updates do not interrupt your voice remote pairing profile.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you Bradley, that's very reassuring.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Just to confirm for the record, the installation address is 34 Glenurquhart Road, correct?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, 34 Glenurquhart Road.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is there anything else with your TV or broadband that I can assist you with today, Fiona?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No, the voice remote was the only issue, and it's working better than before. Thanks for your help.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for choosing S-Net, Fiona, and have a wonderful day.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you Bradley, goodbye.
